volume.title: Lightseeker
volume.author: Cuttlefish That Loves Diving
volume.title_meaning: This volume focused on the idea that humans were small and powerless in front of gods, yet they would still pursue the light. The meaning behind Lightseeker was somewhat similar to Icarus's story; He flew too close to the sun and fell into the sea where he drowned. In this volume, it referred to those who had given their lives to achieve the goal, such as Colin Iliad, Lovia, Ancient Sun God, and many more who were willing to give their lives for what they seek.
volume.synopsis: Amon had captured Klein and was trying to entice the latter with taking over his destiny. Along the way to the Forsaken Land of the Gods, Klein found out that Amon's father, Ancient Sun God, was an Earthling like him. During Klein's multiple attempts to escape Amon, they went into a place named Chernobyl which made Klein realize that he had never 'transmigrated' and that this world is Earth. The realization helped to fully digest his potion. After committing suicide, thanks to the help of the Evernight Goddess, Klein looked back to just before he transmigrated with the luck enhancement ritual and put together that Sefirah Castle chose randomly but only when people did the required procedure with luck enhancement ritual, mysterious silver plate, mutated cell phones and other things. The rest of the volume focuses on Klein's adventure in the Forsaken Land of the Gods until he entered the Giant King's Court and opened up a path to the outside world. Meanwhile, in the outside world, the World War was intensifying before reaching a conclusion with a battle of Gods in Backlund.

timeline_of_major_events.event: Amon and Klein entered the Forsaken Land of the Gods through the Sea of Ruins. Klein's first escape plan failed. All 100 versions of himself plus his true self tried to pull the version of Reinette Tinekerr that used the Yesterday Once More Charm. Failed - Amon took control of the summoned Reinette Tinekerr and all 100 Worm of Spirit were turned into animals due to the curse in the Forsaken Land of the Gods). Fors prayed to the Fool to asked the World about the situation. Derrick prayed to the Fool to asked for Blessing. Klein's second escape plan failed. (Using Scholar of Yore, he pulled the Scarlet Lunar Corona and the Master Key, and attempted to summon the cries of Mr. Door to create a chance to escape. Failed.) Bernadette summons Klein's messenger, but Reinette can't find Klein. Cattleya prayed to the Fool.
Leonard learned the disappearance of Klein from Reinette. He prayed to the Fool. Alger prayed to the Fool to asks for the Unshadowed Crucifix.

Klein's third escape plan failed. During the second escape, Klein scatter some Worm of Spirit to control the near by monsters as a distraction while his main body practiced pulling the Historical Void Projection of Zaratul. He succeeded this time, and with Zaratul's projection distracting Amon, Klein pulled the Historical Void Projection of Arianna to 1. Have the projection kill him and 2. If the first fails, Klein could hide from and prepare for potential battle. During this, the Historical Void Projection of Zaratul pulled the Historical Void Projection of Antigonus and Medici to fight against Amon.) Audrey prayed to the Fool. Xio prayed to the Fool.
